name: inventory-management-application
description: Inventory management application for tracking products, stock levels, and inventory movements

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=frontend" "npm run dev --workspace=backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=backend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=frontend --if-present && npm run test --workspace=backend --if-present
